idea-plugin.name: Cloudflared Runner
idea-plugin.description:
Runs cloudflared quick tunnels and Access clients from a tool window instead of a terminal tab.

  • Quick tunnel — cloudflared tunnel --url <target>, with the generated trycloudflare.com hostname shown in the status column.
  • Access client — cloudflared access tcp --hostname <host> --url <bind>, showing the local bind address.
Output is streamed into a per-connection console, so login prompts and auth URLs stay visible. Running processes are killed when the project closes.

Requires cloudflared on PATH. The plugin does no Cloudflare API calls and handles no credentials — cloudflared does its own authentication.
